title: ZeroDex: Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation via Multi-View 3D-Grounded VLM Reasoning
authors: Jisoo Kim, Sangwon Baik, Taeksoo Kim, Sungjoo Kim, Junyoung Lee, Mingi Choi, Hanbyul Joo

tldr.zh: ZeroDex 用多视角三角化与射线投票，将 VLM 标注的二维操作功能点恢复为三维位置，据此对齐已有工具轨迹、优化抓姿并规划臂手动作，再通过视觉验证与重规划完成零样本长时序操作。
tldr.en: ZeroDex lifts VLM-grounded 2D functional keypoints into 3D using multi-view triangulation and reference-ray voting, aligns stored tool trajectories, optimizes grasps and plans arm–hand motions, then uses visual verification and replanning for zero-shot long-horizon manipulation.

evaluation_scope.zh: VLM 拆解任务并标注抓取、交互及终止位置；跨视角三角化一致性不足时，沿参考视线采样深度候选，由其他视图的 VLM 投票定位。按技能类别检索离线示范／生成的 6D 工具轨迹并对齐当前场景，功能区域约束抓姿，运动规划器筛查整条轨迹的 IK 与碰撞可行性；执行后可继续、重新定位重试或替换子任务计划。无需任务级策略训练，但依赖预训练感知、离线技能库和运动规划；不是 VLA 动作生成。真机为 xArm＋Inspire 手、4–6 个已标定 RGB 相机，另用 FoundationStereo 深度和 FoundationPose 位姿。长时序整理 4/6、烹饪 1/3，包含重试预算 4 内的恢复；其他任务多为 5 或 10 次试验，不代表普遍可靠的长时序成功。当前不支持手内转物等操作。项目页有演示，代码在核验时仍标注待发布。
evaluation_scope.en: A VLM decomposes tasks and identifies grasp, interaction and terminal points. When cross-view triangulation lacks consensus, other views vote over depth candidates on the reference ray. Skill-category retrieval supplies offline recorded/generated 6D tool trajectories aligned to the scene; affordance-constrained grasps and motion planning undergo full-trajectory IK/collision checks. Post-execution decisions continue, re-ground and retry, or replace the subtask plan. No task-specific policy training is required, but pretrained perception, an offline skill library and motion planning are used, rather than VLA action generation. Hardware uses xArm + Inspire with 4–6 calibrated RGB cameras, FoundationStereo depth and FoundationPose poses. Long-horizon organization scores 4/6 and cooking 1/3, including recovery within a retry budget of four; other tasks typically have 5 or 10 trials, not broad evidence of reliable long-horizon performance. In-hand reorientation is unsupported. The project provides demonstrations; code remains marked coming soon at verification.
